title: Alpine Lake at Sunrise
prompt: An alpine lake at sunrise: ridged snow-capped peaks, pine forest on the shoreline, still water reflecting pink light, mist on the surface. The camera skims low over the water toward the mountains.
description: Use a shared heightfield to place shoreline and pines, then shade the rock, snow and distance haze by altitude and slope.
